image_prompt.text: Hospital corridors chaining reception to the examination rooms and the medicine store
Vehicle-width routes into the hospital grounds
shelves stocked with every kind of medicine along one side of the treatment area
security cameras mounted through the hospital with sightlines onto the patients
examination rooms where sick patients are checked over and treated

layout_placement.text: Task stations in the repeatable doctor loop - the check-in desk, each patient bed, the treatment station and the medicine shelf
Individual medicines taken off the shelves to treat a patient
an observation point where the camera feeds are reviewed to judge whether a patient is an anomaly

notes: The whole game is indoors, and Simulation's shapes have no way to say so - the enclosure axis only exists in the no-genre file - so the route emits P0 when an interior-only hospital should almost certainly be carrying P3.
'Anomaly' is never defined in the prompt. It is treated as a patient who looks or behaves wrong on camera, which is a guess.
The prompt is barely punctuated and was read for intent; if the anomaly loop is meant to be the main game rather than the doctor loop, the classification should be revisited.
